recipes.title: Smoky chicken with creamy red lentils and roasted carrots
steps: Peel and chop the carrots and onion. Cut the plain chicken breast into strips. Use only dairy-free ingredients; check any seasoning blend's label.
Toss the carrots with half the oil, salt, cumin and smoked paprika. Roast at 210 °C until browned and tender, about 20–25 minutes.

Soften the onion in the remaining oil. Stir in the rinsed dry red lentils, paprika and about 250 ml water per serving. Simmer 12–18 minutes until soft; add water as needed. Mash lightly for a creamy texture without dairy.

Season the chicken with paprika, pepper and salt. Brown it in a nonstick pan and cook through. Spoon the lentils onto a plate, top with chicken and carrots. Optional pantry vinegar adds brightness; no cream or butter.

recipes.title: Paprika chicken and red lentil skillet
steps: Peel and chop the onion and carrots. Slice plain chicken breast and rinse the dry lentils. Choose dairy-free seasonings.
Brown the chicken in the oil with smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Remove it to a plate.
Soften the onion and carrots in the pan, then add the lentils and about 250 ml water per serving. Simmer until tender, adding water as needed.
Return the chicken and finish cooking it through. Adjust salt and pepper and serve; optional pantry vinegar brightens the lentils.

recipes.title: Cumin chicken with rice and roasted carrots
steps: Cook the dry white rice in water according to its packet instructions. Peel and chop the vegetables.
Roast the carrots and onion at 210 °C with half the oil, cumin, pepper and salt until tender.
Slice plain chicken breast and season it with paprika and cumin. Brown in the remaining oil and cook through.
Serve the chicken over rice with the roasted vegetables. Use dairy-free seasoning blends; no butter, cream or cheese.

recipes.title: Cumin turkey with rice and roasted carrots
steps: Cook the dry white rice in water according to its packet instructions. Peel and chop the vegetables.
Roast the carrots and onion at 210 °C with half the oil, cumin, pepper and salt until tender.
Slice plain turkey breast and season it with paprika and cumin. Brown in the remaining oil and cook through.
Serve the turkey over rice with the roasted vegetables. Use dairy-free seasoning blends; no butter, cream or cheese.

recipes.title: Savory chicken oat porridge
steps: Peel and grate the carrot and chop the onion. Slice plain chicken breast into thin strips.
Soften the onion and carrot in the oil, add the chicken and cook through with salt, pepper and paprika.
Stir in plain dry oat flakes and about 200 ml water per serving. Simmer until creamy, adding water as needed; use water rather than milk.
Serve as a savory breakfast bowl. Use dairy-free seasonings and no butter or cream.

recipes.title: Chicken rice breakfast porridge
steps: Rinse the dry rice. Peel and grate the carrot and chop the onion.
Soften the vegetables in the oil. Add rice and about 350 ml water per serving, then simmer until the rice is very soft, adding water if needed.
Add thinly sliced plain chicken and cook through. Season the porridge with salt, pepper and cumin; use dairy-free seasonings.

recipes.title: Paprika chicken bites with carrot sticks
steps: Peel the carrot and cut it into sticks. Cut plain chicken breast into bite-size pieces.
Coat the chicken in oil, paprika, salt and pepper. Cook through in a nonstick pan.
Serve the small chicken portion with crunchy carrot sticks, without dairy-based dips.

recipes.title: Mini turkey patties with carrots
steps: Finely chop plain turkey breast and peeled onion. Season with salt, pepper and cumin.
Shape small patties and cook through in the oil. Peel and slice the carrot while they cook.
Serve two or three mini patties with carrot sticks; the snack needs no cheese, butter or cream.
